About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Title: 2d CAD Draftsman
We are a timber company who manufactures high end gates, planters, sheds, out buildings and much more from high quality wood.We are looking for a 2D draftsmen to generate a catalogue of 2D PDFs/PNGs that we can sent to customers and use on our website that shows the important dimensions of our products in a customer friendly way.Initially we would want you to work on the 2D drawings of our gates but the role could expand into doing our whole existing catalogue range.Hourly Range: $5.00-$20.00Posted On: February 13, 2024 08:44 UTCCategory: CADSkills:SolidWorks, 2D Design, 3D DesignSkills: SolidWorks, 2D Design, 3D DesignCountry: United Kingdomclick to apply

text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, and I’m a passionate, hard-working full stack developer with 7 years of experience.

I’ve built embedded customer analytics dashboards in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL for a B2B SaaS product, delivering usage dashboards that let each customer account see its own metrics. That project was rolled out to 140 customer accounts and delivered 3 weeks early.

While my background is in web development, I’m comfortable working from clear requirements and turning them into clean, customer-friendly outputs. I’d be interested in helping you create a catalogue of 2D PDFs/PNGs for your gates first, with dimensions presented clearly for your customers and website. If the initial work goes well, I’d be glad to support the wider product range too.
